subject.title: fix(net-policy): nested sensitive query parameters bypass redaction in redactSensitiveUrlLikeString

question: Should maintainers fold this nested-query redaction bug into the open net-policy fallback-scanner PR, or require a separate security-focused fix path?
rationale: The bug is clear and security-sensitive, and an open PR already changes the exact fallback scanner, but it does not explicitly own this newer nested-query report.

options.title: Fold Into The Existing Scanner PR
options.body: Ask the open PR to add explicit nested-query coverage and verify the same shared helper call paths before merge.

options.title: Open A Separate Security Fix
options.body: Keep the candidate PR scoped to suffix preservation and handle nested query scanning in a smaller security-owned patch.

options.title: Broaden To Redactor Alignment
options.body: Pause both paths until maintainers decide whether gateway-client and support-log redactors must adopt the same nested-query behavior now.

recommendation.title: Fold Into The Existing Scanner PR
recommendation.body: Ask the open PR to add explicit nested-query coverage and verify the same shared helper call paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current helper blame and recent merged net-policy redaction decisions point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the security-boundary choice.
